hero.caption: Fuego volcano is an active volcano in Guatemala about 30 km from the UNESCO Heritage Site of Antigua, a town of about 50,000. It erupts or growls continually but recently erupted with a vengeance, destroying the village of Rodeo as well as the high end golf course just outside Antigua. Antigua itself, apart from a 3 or 4 inch dump of volcanic ash has survived well with only damage to gardens from the ash. Currently in the cleanup mode.
